title: SuperHomes
description: This is criminal to be free... A very easy to use and customizable homes plugin with admin features and many more!
body:
Hey, welcome to SuperHomes. SuperHomes is an optimised plugin designed for players to be able to set multiple homes for important locations, unlike most homes plugins SuperHomes is NOT a DonutSMP replica, we are our own unique plugin with admin and player commands.

**IMPORTANT NOTICES:**
- You can edit all messages via config.yml
- Default is SQLite but you can enable MySQL via config.yml
- Do not tamper with things you do not know how to correctly configure, I advise always asking a developer to do so for you.
